title: Horizontal safety netting systems requirements.
officialText:
Horizontal safety netting systems shall meet the requirements of
Sections 5, 6.3, 6.4, 6.5, 6.6, 7, 8, 10.1, 10.4, 10.5, 10.6, 10.7, 11, and 13 of ANSI/ASSE A10.11, as modified as follows.
